description:
An intuitive diagram software with templates for any scenario.

EdrawMax is a powerful, all-in-one, and yet easy-to-use diagramming tool that enables users to visualize the ideas effortlessly. With EdrawMax, you can create and customize flowcharts, Venn diagrams, mind maps, organizational charts, Gantt charts, UML diagrams, electrical drawings, genograms, building plans, etc.
- Fully revamped visual design for the Agent homepage, delivering a cleaner interface and more intuitive operations.
- Added a multi-turn conversation page with immersive generation support, making the creation workflow more seamless and efficient.
- Optimized generation quality for flowcharts, swimlane diagrams, architecture diagrams and technology roadmaps, with more accurate diagram structures and more professional visual presentation.
